title: 第六百九十四章 两界联通第六百九十三章 先成个仙
content_zh:
第六百九十四章两界联通
原本在京都附近的各个县衙，各地收拢兵马，直接招兵买马的时候，还碰到过一些小问题。
地头蛇哪都有。
更别说天子脚下，更是如同那灵山脚下。
越是光明的地方，越是隐藏黑暗。
什么来历的地头蛇都有。
不过不慌，左千勇别的手段没有，但是杀人那是真的快。
他那几把随着他征战各地的宝刀，还有身上带着的飞镖等武器，本身就杀过不少人，带着些血煞之气。
等他一举修成通窍之后，更是将这些兵器里面的金精之气，血煞之气炼成了一道飞剑。
别人的剑气煌煌光明。
左前勇的剑气好像是一抹血色。
敢炸刺？
杀！
我管你是异地县城还是什么所谓的知府。
有钱有粮有实力。
大夏王朝已经完蛋了，我们要建立大乾道庭。
没有一合之敌。
完全没有一合之敌！
……
南方一处水乡之地。

只见到，现如今已经领着数万大军来到这里的左千勇，这是直接派兵，对着关闭的城池送去信件:
“告诉他们，三日之内大开城池，迎王师进城，既往不咎，否则待到王师入城，便审判所有罪孽！”
听到了左千勇如此说，原本只是乡野农夫，但是跟随了左迁勇一直杀杀杀所向无敌，近乎练成精兵的传令兵则是面色一肃:
“是！”
话语落下，他则是直接单枪匹马。
直接就向着那城中走去。
把普通人练成精兵的最简单的方法，就是把他们拉到战场上，百战百胜。
兵仙韩信就是走的这一条道路。
就算你再是普通人，随着军队每一战必胜，杀敌无数的时候，都变成了自信无比，实力强悍的精兵。
信入了城。
如今守在此地的各大大家，甚至包括知府县城都聚到一起，商量:
“如今敌军已经兵临城下了，咱们是降还是不降？”
听到了知府如此说。
黄张文李四大家族，也就是现如今所谓的世家之人，却是直接冷哼一声，开口道:
“百年皇朝，千年世家，我们支持他，他才是王朝，我们不支持他，他也就是个山野流寇。”
content_en:
Chapter 694: Connecting the Two Realms
Originally, when various county offices near Kyoto gathered troops and directly recruited troops, they encountered some minor problems.
There are local snakes everywhere.
Not to mention the foot of the emperor, it is even like the foot of the Lingshan Mountain.
The brighter the place, the more darkness is hidden.
There are local snakes from all origins.
But don't panic, Zuo Qianyong has no other means, but he kills people really quickly.
His few precious swords that followed him in various battles, as well as the darts and other weapons he carried with him, had killed many people themselves, and they carried a certain blood-evil aura.
After he mastered the Qi in one fell swoop, he refined the golden spirit and blood evil spirit in these weapons into a flying sword.
Others' sword energy is bright and bright.
Zuo Qianyong's sword energy seemed to be a touch of blood.
Dare to explode?
kill!
I don't care if you are in a different county or some so-called prefect.
Have money, food and strength.
The Great Xia Dynasty is over, we need to establish the Daqian Taoist Court.
There is no single enemy.
There is no single enemy at all!
…
A water town in the south.
I only saw that Zuo Qianyong, who has now led tens of thousands of troops here, is directly sending troops to send a letter to the closed city:
"Tell them to open the city within three days and welcome the king's troops into the city, and let bygones be bygones. Otherwise, they will be judged for all their sins when the king's troops enter the city!"
Hearing what Zuo Qianyong said, the orderly soldier who was originally just a country farmer, but followed Zuo Qianyong and killed everyone invincibly, and was almost trained as an elite soldier, had a serious look on his face:
"Yes!"
After the words fell, he went straight to work alone.
Walk directly towards the city.
The simplest way to train ordinary people into elite soldiers is to drag them onto the battlefield and win every battle.
The soldier immortal Han Xin took this path.
Even if you are an ordinary person, as the army wins every battle and kills countless enemies, you have become an elite soldier with incomparable confidence and strength.
The letter entered the city.
Now everyone who is guarding this place, including the prefect and county seat, have gathered together to discuss:
"Now that the enemy has reached the city, should we surrender or not?"
I heard the prefect say this.
The four major families of Huang, Zhang, Wen and Li, which are now called aristocratic families, snorted coldly and said:
"A century-old dynasty, a thousand-year-old family. If we support him, he is the dynasty. If we don't support him, he will just be a mountain bandit."
